steps.note: Open the events list to locate the existing draft.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required vendor-addition restriction for event creation.
Apply the additional tenant configuration specified by the case.
Verify the events list rendered successfully.
Switch to the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Open the existing saved draft; the draft reopens on its create screen.
Open the draft's participant and All Vendors window.
Verify that the All Vendors window opened.
Capture the current All Vendors region before applying the search.
Enter the vendor search text from the test case.
Confirm the search field contains the requested query.
Verify that the All Vendors content changed after searching.
Verify that the matching vendor appears in the filtered vendor list.
